shipped_schema_differences: BAS uses actions rather than the published example's annotations array and uppercase labels.
BAS frame is one-based and equals the GSR image-id suffix; video frame is BAS frame minus one and round(position_ms / 40).
BAS player_id is numeric text while GSR attributes.player_id is an integer; identity matching needs type normalization.
GSR is a COCO-style info/images/annotations object, not the older documented flat-record array.

blinded_local_touch_review.control_limitation: No BAS event within 50 frames is not proof no physical touch occurred.

limitations: BAS actions are event and actor/timing proxies, not independently reviewed physical first touches.
The event-interpolated SoccerTrack ball track must not be used as independent ball-position truth against BAS events.
This source has no challenge Smart Tagging or complete per-frame possession-spell truth.
No challenge video, output-video review, public possession reference or protected truth was used.
decision: Keep the source-only exit-bracket submission. The blinded local physical-touch packet is prepared but all 24 cases are unreviewed; do not promote a flight-owner model on event alignment or an empty review packet.
